about: Read by Duo and Trio at most once in 7 days (GitHub raw first, then polyhelper.ai/duo/version.json). A shortcut whose built-in number is lower than the number here offers its <name>_<lang> iCloud link. To release: raise the number, rebuild and sign (tools/build.sh), re-create the iCloud links from the new files, put them here, copy this file to poly-a1 site/duo/version.json, push.
